packageRules.description: npm lockfile regeneration is the most failure-prone artifact update (optional wasm/native deps). Group it separately so one bad artifact cannot strand every other ecosystem's updates.
cargo update regenerates Cargo.lock per workspace; keep it separate from file-edit-only managers for the same blast-radius reason as npm.
macos-26 breaks the .NET MAUI iOS build (default Xcode 26); see https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1627

Driver tarballs bundle copies npm overrides cannot replace. iOS 12.16.0 bundles only shell-quote 1.10.0; Android 8.7.0 additionally bundles axios 1.19.0, brace-expansion 5.0.9, morgan 1.11.0, proxy-addr 2.0.7, sharp 0.35.4 — uiautomator2 9.0.0-beta.1 fixes all but shell-quote, so hold Android for the stable 9.x. See https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1995
sprintf-js was removed via the scoped js-yaml@5.4.3 override under @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config (#1996). Keep that override until upstream load-nyc-config drops the js-yaml@3 chain.
